title: search_knowledge request
description: The params object of the `search_knowledge` tool. Ranked, cited chunks for an open question. Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

query.description: The question or words to search for.

candidate_k.description: How many candidates each channel gathers before fusion.

path_prefix.description: Only record paths starting with this prefix (`root_id/path` form).

retrieval_mode.description: lexical uses words only; vector and hybrid need an index with vectors, else vectors are ignored.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.

search_field.description: Opt-in filename navigation or combined lexical retrieval; requires explicit lexical retrieval_mode. both (since 2.3.0) ranks each file once by its best passage's score plus its folder and file names' title part, a score-level merge that candidate_k does not cut.
